meta.seo_title: Health Centre Google Ads Case Study | PPC Guru
meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru launched a Toronto physiotherapy and massage health centre on Google Ads and scaled it to about 9 genuine phone leads a month at roughly $59 each in Q2 2026.

headline: How a Toronto Health Centre Launched on Google Ads and Grew to ~9 Phone Leads a Month
summary_line: PPC Guru launched a fresh Google Ads account for a Toronto physiotherapy and massage health centre in early 2026 and, in the first full quarter under management (April–June 2026), grew it to about nine genuine phone-call leads a month at roughly $59 each — up from a single tracked call in the launch month, with a conversion rate near 9%.
client_context: Palmdale Health Center is a physiotherapy and registered massage therapy (RMT) practice serving patients across Toronto, including the Scarborough and North York areas. The clinic offers hands-on physiotherapy, massage therapy and related wellness treatments, and books patients through the JaneApp scheduling system. Like most local clinics, its growth depends on a steady flow of new-patient enquiries — phone calls and online bookings from people searching for treatment nearby — which makes reliable call tracking central to measuring what the advertising actually produces.
background: The clinic wanted a measurable, well-tracked Google Ads presence built around genuine patient enquiries rather than vanity clicks. PPC Guru launched a fresh Search account in early 2026 with call tracking and lead measurement in place from day one, then grew spend month by month as the phone-call data proved the channel was working.
analysis: Because this was a launch rather than a turnaround, PPC Guru put measurement first: wire up call tracking and lead signals before scaling, focus the budget on high-intent local searches, and let genuine phone-call volume — not raw click counts — guide how quickly to grow.
analysis_points: Stand up call tracking (website calls and calls from ads) plus lead-form and JaneApp booking signals from launch.
Separate genuine phone-call leads from Google Business Profile local actions and booking-button clicks so reporting reflects real enquiries.
Concentrate budget on high-intent local searches such as 'physiotherapy near me' and 'massage therapy near me'.
Grow spend gradually, only as monthly phone-lead volume confirmed the channel was converting.

timeline.what: PPC Guru launched the account with call tracking in place — one tracked phone lead in the first month as the campaigns ramped.
Two genuine phone leads as targeting and negative keywords settled.
Phone leads climbed to 5 then 11 a month as budget was extended on proven searches.
About 9 genuine phone leads a month — peaking at 12 in June — at roughly $59 per lead and a conversion rate near 9%.

challenge: Launching a new local health-centre account means starting from zero data. Early on, spend has to work hard for its first genuine enquiries, and the account's real conversion signals — phone calls to the clinic — need to be separated from Google Business Profile local actions and booking-page button clicks that can otherwise make raw conversion counts look larger than the true number of patient enquiries.

changes.why: A physiotherapy Search campaign and a dedicated RMT (massage) campaign kept budget on the two core service lines and their high-intent local searches.
Website call and call-from-ads tracking captured phone enquiries — the clinic's primary lead type — from the very first month.
Phone-call leads were reported separately from local actions and JaneApp booking-button clicks so the clinic saw real enquiry counts.
Monthly spend was increased only as phone-lead volume grew, keeping cost per lead falling as the account matured.
Ongoing negative-keyword work kept traffic on treatment-intent searches in Scarborough and North York.

benchmark: Figures use genuine phone-call leads only. Raw account 'Conversions' read higher from June 2026 because a booking-page button-click action (janeapp_click) and Google Business Profile local actions are also recorded — those are excluded here so the numbers reflect real patient calls.

early_stage.title: The First 90 Days
early_stage.intro: The launch quarter showed a clear, compounding ramp. The first month produced a single tracked phone lead while the campaigns gathered data; by the third month cost per lead had already fallen from about $293 to roughly $98 as genuine call volume grew.

gradual: From there, genuine phone leads compounded month over month rather than spiking once and fading: 1 in February, 2 in March, 5 in April, 11 in May and 12 in June, before a quieter July (7) as part of the natural month-to-month variation of a real account. Cost per lead fell in step, from roughly $293 in the launch month to about $59 across the most recent complete quarter. The trend below shows a steady early climb rather than a one-off spike.
lessons: Track phone calls from the first day — for a local clinic, calls are the highest-intent enquiry.
Separate genuine calls from Google Business Profile local actions and booking-button clicks so your reported numbers stay honest.
Give a new account a few months to gather data before judging cost per lead.
Scale budget gradually, following genuine lead volume rather than raw click counts.
Keep negative keywords current so local searches reach the right neighbourhoods.
why_it_worked: Call tracking was in place from launch, so budget decisions followed genuine phone enquiries.
Two focused Search campaigns kept spend on core physiotherapy and massage searches.
Genuine-lead reporting kept vanity actions out of the numbers used to scale.
Budget grew only as the phone-lead data proved the channel was converting.
outcome: In just its first full quarter under management, Palmdale Health Center went from a single tracked phone lead in the launch month to about nine genuine phone-call leads a month across April–June 2026, peaking at 12 in June, at roughly $59 per lead and a conversion rate near 9%. The account now has clean call tracking, a focused two-campaign structure and a clear, data-backed basis to keep scaling as demand grows.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian clinics launch and scale Google Ads that generate genuine patient enquiries, with honest call tracking and transparent reporting.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the clinic's Google Ads account and shown on a monthly basis. 'Leads' are genuine phone-call conversions only — Google Business Profile local actions and JaneApp booking-button clicks are excluded so counts reflect real enquiries. 'Now' is the most recent complete quarter (April–June 2026); the launch month (February 2026) is the baseline.
lead_quality: Every tracked lead in this study is a phone call to the clinic — the highest-intent enquiry type for a local health centre — captured from both website and ad call extensions.
